job.job_description:
Job Description
We are looking for a motivated GenAI Developer with 1-2 years of experience in designing and developing AI-powered applications using Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Python, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI/ML concepts.
Experience: 1-2yrs
Location: Bangalore
Roles Responsibilities
Develop and maintain Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Design effective prompts and optimize model responses.
Build AI applications using Python and relevant AI frameworks.
Integrate GenAI solutions with enterprise applications and APIs.
Perform testing, debugging, and performance optimization of AI applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver AI-driven solutions.
Technical Requirement
1-2 years of experience in Python development.
Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and RAG concepts.
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of REST APIs, Git, and software development best practices.
Basic understanding of Machine Learning and NLP concepts.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Additional Responsibility
Experience with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB).
Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Knowledge of SQL and data handling.
Educational Requirement
Bachelor of Engineering
Preferred Skills
Technology->AI-AI Engineering->AI/ML Solution Architecture and Design->generative ai
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Prompt Engineering
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Generative AI - Basic
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Generative AI for Data Analytics
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Conversational AI Platform
Service Line
Information Systems
